name: Photon iMessage wake
order: read bound batch and consumed input revision
resolve existing task, permitted input association and context
creationAuthority: explicit bootstrap using inspected native tool schema; no normal-wake creation
acknowledgement: HTTP 200 starts a run; not task completion
readContract: Read inputRevision, acknowledgedRevision, continuationReason, original source references and results from bridge storage after acquiring the current claim.
completion: Acknowledge only the consumed inputRevision; later persisted work remains actionable.
taskResults: Workers report the recorded local taskId, task inputRevision, correlationId and receipt through task-result without the expired parent token; resume-task obtains fresh processing authority.
